title: The one who eats forgetfully
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said about a fasting person who forgets and eats
arabic: إِذَا نَسِيَ فَأَكَلَ وَشَرِبَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ
translation: If he forgets and eats and drinks, let him complete his fast, for it is Allah who fed him and gave him drink.

witnesses.name: dorar
